summary:
BUY 31 CEILING AIR DEVICES: 28 ceiling supply diffusers + 3 ceiling return/exhaust grilles. All are Price Industries (or approved equal), all new — MD101 removes every existing grille and nothing is salvaged, so there are no reused devices.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS (28) — Price SCD, louvered face square 4-cone steel, white, fixed 360° 4-way pattern, full-faced louvers, factory insulated backpan, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling, with a radial balancing damper (Price VCR9 or equal) in the neck. Order by neck size:
  - Type A, 6" round neck ....... 5 ea (75, 75, 75, 90, 130 CFM)
  - Type B, 8" round neck ....... 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
  - Type C, 10" round neck ...... 15 ea (250x4, 200x2, 350x3, 375x4, 300x2 CFM)
  - Type D, 12" round neck ...... 1 ea (500 CFM)
  Plus Type J — Price SMD, louvered face high-capacity steel ceiling supply diffuser, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way, FLANGED FRAME for surface mounting (hard/tectum ceiling, not lay-in), opposed blade damper ... 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM)
  Ceiling supply subtotal: 28 diffusers / 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN-EXHAUST GRILLES (3) — Type F, Price model 80, 24" x 24" CORE-ONLY panel, all-aluminum 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" egg crate, white, in 24x24 lay-in ceiling ... 3 ea (no CFM tagged; these are return/exhaust). One is over FCU-1 (M101 note 4 requires a new 24x24 lined 1" plenum above it, existing 15x12 duct modified into the top — field verify); the other two are in MTG ROOM 106 (note 4 also applies, with the existing 15x12 duct field-verified).

ALSO ORDER (ceiling-adjacent, easy to miss): 1 ea 14" x 14" egg crate, Price model 82, mounted in the SOFFIT with an insect screen on the back — this is the outside-air intake, called out by note 19 on M101 only, it is NOT in the grille schedule and carries no tag.

NOT CEILING — these 15 are WALL-mounted, do not put them in the ceiling-diffuser order:
  - Type E, 30x18, Price 95, primecoat, heavy-duty steel 0° deflection sidewall RETURN grille ... 4 ea. FIELD VERIFY: the schedule asterisks this size and note 7 says the engineer could not field-measure the existing openings — "grille dimensions are approximately 30 x 18 (each) but contractor shall field verify exact sizes prior to ordering."
  - Type G, 36x36, Price 95, primecoat, sidewall TRANSFER grille, top elevation 14'-8" A.F.F. ... 4 ea (2 wall openings, a grille each face).
  - Type H, 18x8, Price 520D, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall SUPPLY, opposed blade damper ... 3 ea (550 CFM each).
  - Type I, 14x8, Price 520D, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall SUPPLY, opposed blade damper ... 4 ea (450 CFM each). Also asterisked — field verify exact dimension before ordering.
  Total supply air including sidewall grilles checks out at exactly 10,000 CFM.

DO NOT BUY GRILLES FOR THE EXHAUST FANS: EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) are centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans supplied WITH an integral grille, plus flapper backdraft damper, plug and cord set, mounting brackets, factory grille-mounted motion sensor and speed controller. They are ceiling air openings but the grille comes with the fan.

FINISH NOTE: A, B, C, D, F and J are factory WHITE. E, G, H and I ship PRIMECOAT and get 2 coats of field paint — verify color with the architect (schedule note 13).

COORDINATION: M601 general note 3 — coordinate all ceiling register locations with the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and ceiling grid; refer to the architectural reflected ceiling plans for exact locations.

Sheets used: M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan — the device count; it is the only plan in the set with air-device tags), M601 (Mechanical Legend, General Notes & Schedules — GRILLES schedule types A-J, exhaust fan schedule, schedule notes 1-13), MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan — confirms existing ceiling/sidewall supply and return grilles are removed and replaced with new, nothing salvaged), M501 (Mechanical Details — ceiling grille duct connection detail, typical flex runout to diffusers).
